name: Electron and CEF apps
author: Cell
summary: Launchers and apps built on Chromium (Electron, CEF) draw their window inside the main process, the fix that keeps Steam's window from staying blank or black.
useWhen: A launcher or app built on Electron or CEF opens a black, white or empty window.

notes: Chromium's separate GPU process can't draw into another process's window under Wine on macOS, so the window stayed empty. These switches keep drawing in the app itself.
